mapping.fallback: When a slot is not ready, or its image fails to load, the result page keeps the existing canvas fallback portrait.
batchIngestionSteps: Generate one portrait per pending slot using the slot id and prompt brief.
Save the preview image to expectedFile.
Set the slot status to ready and copy expectedFile into file.
Append a reviewed item record with the same id to items.
Keep file paths relative to the site root so index.html can load them directly.
